title: OmniAb Announces Global Collaboration and License Agreement for Ion Channel Program with Eli Lilly & Company
summary: EMERYVILLE, Calif., August 17, 2026--OmniAb, Inc. (NASDAQ: OABI), a provider of cutting-edge discovery research technology to enable the discovery of next-generation therapeutics, today announced a global collaboration and license agreement with Eli Lilly and Company (Lilly) for a new ion channel program.
